scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w staff && npm run build -w admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w staff && npm run lint -w admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @iws/api-client && npm run typecheck -w @iws/ui && npm run typecheck -w @iws/auth && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w staff && npm run typecheck -w admin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @iws/api-client && npm run test -w @iws/ui && npm run test -w @iws/auth && npm run test -w api && npm run test -w staff && npm run test -w admin
scripts.api:gen: npm run api:openapi && npm run api:client
scripts.qa:gate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
